speaker: Head Coach
quote_text:
OK, who wants to get us underway? James? The  reaction to that, pretty much a perfect afternoon?  
Yes, good afternoon in terms of we won, that is  important. And then also the performance in this  
kind of games, you have to show how serious, how  professional you are. And I think once again the  
players, they show that. What did you make of  Tosin this afternoon? His overall performance  
as well as the goals. Yeah, it's a little bit  also the, the picture of the game in terms of  
he was most of the time the only one. Without with  more space because all the rest they were men to  
men inside the box. There was not space. He was  the only one that he can carry the ball and tried  
that option and we are happy for him. Did you know  he could strike a ball like that? Yeah, no. Yeah,  
he can. He can do that. The only thing that from  central defender you struggle a little bit to see  
them at the edge of the box attacking. But when we  arrive there we have to we have to try that kind  
of. As I said, the solution also, Axel Disasi try  a few times. That means that our central defender,  
they are at the edge of the box and this is  is it's it's a good thing. Will you encourage  
Tosin to shoot more now? No exaggerate. And no  Madueke in the squad today, what's that about? No,  
it was just because yesterday he didn't  finish the session because of unwell,  
so this was the reason why. And Reece James, first  football since the hamstring injury. What did you  
make with him and he came off at half-time, was  that precautionary? Yeah, Yeah for him and for  
Romeo Lavia was just to protect them. The idea was  to play 45 minutes and hopefully we can start from  
there and build some physical condition and allow  them to be with us until the rest of the season.  
And finally, from me, Carney Chukwuemeka,  any contact yet from Dortmund in terms of  
a loan deal? For who? Carney Chukwuemeka? No. No,  I don't know. To be honest. No, I don't think so.  
OK. Thank you. I just wanted to know kind of  like how are you going to build up with Reece  
James and Romeo Lavia? Are we going to see this  kind of thing a lot? How long will it take to  
sort of see them play 90 minutes? Yeah, the idea  is to slowly, slowly build the right condition,  
especially probably for Reece. You have to be a  little bit more careful. So now the good thing  
is that they both play 45 minutes, they both  finish well, not any problem. And now hopefully  
now we can, we can as I said, we can start to  help them to build the right condition. How  
do you think Tyrique George did today? Good,  good. George, Tyrique is doing well with us.  
He already played some games, especially in the  Conference. He's same age than Josh Acheampong,  
very young both. So hopefully we can. with them,  we can give them more chances and they can also  
become an important part of this this team.  Nkunku's now 13 goals, Joao Felix I think 7,  
they've both got a lot of big game experience.  Are they knocking on your door a lot asking  
to play more and start more in the Premier League?  Are they sort of putting pressure on you? No,  
they didn't knock on the door. They didn't ask  nothing, but they don't need to ask. You can see,  
you can see that they they show like tonight. But  I think to the two games ago against Ipswich, we  
start with the with the Joao and Christo. So the  previous game we also start with some game with  
them. So I think they they got the chance already  in the Premier League and that means that every  
time they play in the Premier they have to score  or assist. Important thing is when we need them,  
they are there. I just want to ask a question  for Monday. Can I just ask one more, just in  
terms of this competition and how important a run  is now given that the ... is done in March? Yeah,  
it's an important competition, but since  we start, I think we are trying to. to deal  
or to treat the same competition, all the  competition the same way, Premier League,  
Conference, unfortunately Carabao, we lost against  Newcastle, now FA Cup, and we try to do our best  
in all the competition. Cool, thank you. We'll  do a few questions at the side for Monday.
title: Enzo Maresca post-match press conference | Chelsea 5-0 Morecambe
